correctness.rationale: The directed graph of a nilpotent injective partial map with rank k has k arrows in disjoint chains, so nilpotency index <=k+1; equality requires a single chain of k+1 vertices. Order preservation makes successive forward iterates strictly increasing (or decreasing) by induction, forcing forward/backward shifts along ordered support. For a forward shift contraction, successive positive gaps satisfy d_{i+1}<=d_i; these partitions of span m are counted by p_k(m) with n-m shifts and 2 orientations. The formal partition Euler product produces the stated GF; Hardy–Ramanujan plus a uniform exponentially decaying j/sqrt(n) tail controls E_n~(12/pi²)n p(n) and hence constant sqrt(3)/pi². Independently enumerated every rank-k partial monotone contraction for n=5,6,7,8 and direct composition nilpotency, matching rank vectors and sums. The infinite asymptotic is analytical, not inferred from enumeration.
